tqdm: Accepted by the owner on 2026-11-11: MPL-2.0, redistributed unmodified as a faster-whisper dependency; licence text ships in the installer notices and the source is available from PyPI/GitHub.
ctranslate2: Accepted 2026-11-12 (decision delegated by the owner): ctranslate2 itself is MIT. NVIDIA cuDNN is stripped from the installer (CPU-only build). The remaining libiomp5md.dll (Intel OpenMP runtime, required for CPU transcription) is redistributed unmodified in object form as part of the application under the Intel End User License Agreement for Developer Tools (Aug 2024), section 2.1 (Redistributables); Intel's licence text ships in the installer notices. Whether this exact DLL is on Intel's redist list was not verifiable from the wheel; confirm in the human redistribution review.
FFmpeg: Accepted 2026-11-12 (decision delegated by the owner) for the pinned AgenEditor build only (scripts/build_ffmpeg.py; the report checks the binary hash): FFmpeg 9.0.2 with x264, dav1d, libass, freetype, fribidi, harfbuzz and zlib, licensed GPL-2.0-or-later as a whole. Shipped as separate ffmpeg.exe/ffprobe.exe programs run as subprocesses (not linked into the Apache-2.0 engine). The installer ships FFmpeg's licence text, FFmpeg-build-info.json and FFmpeg-SOURCE.txt; every release attaches ffmpeg-corresponding-source.tar (all source tarballs plus the exact build scripts), offering source from the same place as the binaries (GPL-2.0 section 3).
